rules.name: Meticulous Planning
rules.description: Once per game, you may draw three Event Cards instead of one. Choose your preferred card and reshuffle the others into the deck.

rules.name: Master Mage
rules.description: Once per round, after successfully casting a Spell, Savos may cast the same Spell again as a Free Action (as long as he has sufficient Magicka).

rules.name: More Power!
rules.description: When casting Destruction Spells, Faralda may treat every point of Magicka that she spends on Boosts as 2 points.

rules.name: Antagonistic
rules.description: When included in a College of Winterhold Party, Ancano cannot be the Champion, not can he issue Commands.

rules.name: Duplicity
rules.description: When Ancano is targeted by a Ranged Attack, he may take an Intelligence Attribute Test. If this test is passed, choose a friendly model within 3" of Ancano to take the attack on his behalf, even if it was not in range or Line of Sight [of the Attacker].

rules.name: College Administrator
rules.description: At the start of the game, take one [RED] for each friendly College of Winterhold Hero in the Party (including Mirabelle), and use them to form a special dice pool on this card. At the start of each of her activations, Mirabelle may assign one of these dice to herself or a single friendly Hero within 6", to be added to any Skill Test they take that round. If the die is not used before the end of the round, it is lost.

rules.name: Peace-Loving Spriggan-Hugger
rules.description: Colette does not receive a Critical Hit bonus when rolling [CRITICAL] for an Attack. Treat the roll as a score of 1.

rules.name: Overconfident
rules.description: The first time J'Zargo rolls a [CRITICAL] for a Skill Test in each round, after resolving the Test he must take a Wisdom Attribute Test. If this is passed, J'Zargo gains a Ready Token (even if he already Attacked this round). If the Test is failed, however, J'Zargo loses 1 Stamina point.
